overview: The Medford City Council recognized a local community leader, adopted a FEMA hazard mitigation plan, and approved Community Development Block Grant funding. The Council also addressed multiple sign appeals, street infrastructure issues, and proposed residential developments.

items.title: Commendation for Mae Marquebreuck
items.summary: The Council presented a commendation to Mae Marquebreuck honoring her 25 years of service with the Friends of Chevalier Auditorium and GMAC Gymnasium, alongside a resolution celebrating her birthday.

items.title: Historic Properties Demolition Delay Ordinance
items.summary: The Council approved the third reading of paper 17-371, amending Chapter 48 regarding demolition delay regulations for historic properties.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Forno Fogo Healthy Options
items.summary: The Council approved a common victualler license petition for Forno Fogo Healthy Options to operate inside Gold's Gym at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: FY18 Community Development Block Grant Public Hearing
items.summary: The Council approved the Year 43 Community Development Block Grant budget, amended to request letters to federal and state delegations advocating for level funding.

items.title: Sign Denial Reversal Appeal for Global Healthcare Enterprises
items.summary: The Council referred a sign denial appeal for 5 High Street to the Subcommittee on Signs, Business and Economic Development due to concerns about internal illumination and street aesthetics.

items.title: Sign Denial Reversal Appeal for Wayside Youth and Family
items.summary: The Council referred a sign denial appeal for 5 High Street to the Subcommittee on Signs to coordinate signage placement with other building tenants.

items.title: Sign Denial Reversal Appeal for Evangelical Haitian Church
items.summary: The Council referred a sign denial appeal for 400 High Street to the Subcommittee on Signs to review revised dimensions and address potential traffic safety concerns.

items.title: Unpermitted No-Parking Signs and Modular Home Transport
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting administrative updates regarding unauthorized no-parking notices posted for modular home transport on South and Walnut Streets, along with clarification on city moving procedures.

items.title: Adoption of FEMA Hazard Mitigation Plan
items.summary: The Council adopted a resolution approving Medford's updated hazard mitigation plan, maintaining the city's eligibility for federal disaster mitigation grants.

items.title: Macklin Road Subdivision and 252 Main Street Review
items.summary: The Council passed resolutions requesting updates from environmental boards regarding the proposed Macklin Road subdivision and directing an engineering review of street pitch and drainage on McCormick Avenue.

items.title: Tree Stump Removal Ordinance and Infrastructure Repairs
items.summary: The Council referred a proposal to establish a 30-day timeline for tree stump removals to the Public Works Subcommittee and requested specific sidewalk, pole, and trench repairs.

items.title: Potholes, Crosswalk Striping, and City Service Delivery
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution calling for immediate pothole and crosswalk repairs, an estimate to resurface emergency arteries, and a Committee of the Whole meeting with the DPW director.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for Richard 'Bubba' Matos
items.summary: The Council approved a condolence resolution for the family of community member Richard 'Bubba' Matos following his passing.

items.title: Public Input on Condominium Conversions
items.summary: The Council voted to receive and place on file a resident's petition regarding the impact of developer-led condominium conversions on residential neighborhoods.

items.title: Report on Municipal Aggregation Subcommittee Meeting
items.summary: The Council accepted a committee report detailing discussions on municipal aggregation energy programs and potential home rule opt-in options.
